name: Claude Projects
description: Anthropic's project feature within Claude.ai — self-contained workspaces combining chat history, a dedicated knowledge base (uploaded files), and custom instructions, all scoped per project. Context and artifacts persist across conversations within the project.

identity_and_auth.user_identity_model: Account required. Users authenticate to Claude.ai via OAuth (Continue with Google or Apple) or a passwordless email magic link (one-time secure login link / cross-device verification code). No anonymous/device-local usage — a verified account is mandatory. Enterprise/Team organizations support SSO/SAML for org-managed identity. Identity is account-scoped, not API-key based for the consumer Projects product.
identity_and_auth.multi_user_collaboration: Supported on paid tiers. Pro/Team/Enterprise users can organize chats into Projects and share their best Project chats with teammates. Team and Enterprise plans add granular sharing permissions and a 'Shared with me' tab. Projects can be shared with the whole organization or with specific users only. Removing a user from an org revokes remaining members' access to that user's chats (including org-shared snapshots). Free users can create up to 5 projects; Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise get unlimited projects.

workspace_model.workspace_definition: A 'Project' is an account-scoped, fully virtual named entity in Anthropic's cloud — not a directory or git repo. Each Project is a self-contained workspace bundling three components: (1) chat histories within the project, (2) a dedicated knowledge base of uploaded reference documents, and (3) custom instructions. It does not map to a filesystem path; it is a curated corpus + instruction set + conversation collection stored in Anthropic's backend. Each project carries a 200K-token context window for its knowledge.
workspace_model.workspace_session_binding: Conversations are scoped to a Project. Each chat started inside a Project inherits that project's knowledge base and custom instructions. A user can run multiple separate conversations (sessions) within the same Project simultaneously, and conversations outside any Project exist globally on the account. History search is scoped: searches within a project are limited to that project; chats outside projects are searched as a separate global pool.
workspace_model.context_scoping: Workspace-level (per-project): uploaded knowledge-base files and custom instructions apply automatically to every conversation in that project. Session-level: the individual conversation's running token context. Global/account-level: the separate opt-in Memory feature (Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise) and chats outside projects. Knowledge base uses retrieval — only the most relevant document sections are pulled into active context per query rather than loading the entire corpus.
workspace_model.config_file_instruction_precedence: No on-disk config files (this is a cloud chat product, not a CLI). Behavior is shaped by per-project 'Custom Instructions' set in the project settings UI, plus account-level Memory and the user's global preferences. Precedence is effectively: project custom instructions (workspace-level) layered with project knowledge base, on top of any account-global memory/preferences. There is no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md cascade in this product. [uncertain]
workspace_model.source_corpus_grounding_scope: Each Project has a dedicated knowledge base acting as a bounded source corpus. Files are uploaded via the UI (up to 30MB per file; effectively unlimited number of files, supporting PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, HTML, and more). Pro/Team/Enterprise plans enable advanced RAG that greatly expands knowledge-base capacity beyond the 200K window via retrieval. Claude performs retrieval-based reasoning, pulling relevant sections into context per query. No automatic source sync — updating a document requires manual deletion of the old version and re-upload.

persistence_and_history.persistence_mechanism: Cloud-managed storage in Anthropic's backend (managed database; specific engine not publicly documented). Project content (knowledge base, custom instructions) is cached so it does not count against per-message usage limits. State is mutable (files can be added/removed, instructions edited). Enterprise supports customer-managed keys, configurable data residency region, and custom data retention controls. Exact DB/cache implementation is not disclosed. [uncertain]
persistence_and_history.session_history: Conversations are stored server-side and browsable in the Claude.ai UI, organized per project. Individual users (Free/Pro/Max) can export account data including chat history from Settings > Privacy on web/desktop (not iOS/Android). Team/Enterprise members cannot self-export; only the org Primary Owner can export org data from Organization settings > Data and privacy. Export format is a downloadable data archive (JSON-based). [uncertain]
persistence_and_history.memory_layering: Distinct layers: (1) per-project custom instructions and knowledge base = user-authored, durable, workspace-scoped; (2) the separate account-level Memory feature (Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise) = opt-in, user-reviewable/editable cross-thread store that is NOT auto-profiling — Claude only recalls when explicitly enabled and requested, and memory is reviewable/editable, importable/exportable from other platforms; (3) ephemeral per-conversation token context = short-term. Anthropic emphasizes no silent background profile-building.
persistence_and_history.search_retrieval_history: Chat search available to paid plans (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise) on web, Desktop, and Mobile. Implemented via RAG and surfaced as visible tool calls during conversations. Search scope is bucketed: across all non-project chats, OR within an individual project (project searches are limited to that specific project). Past-chat search is disabled when an org uses customer-managed keys. Lets a new conversation retrieve prior context without manual copy-paste.
persistence_and_history.lifecycle_ttl_cleanup: Chats and projects persist until deleted by the user. For Enterprise, data is retained indefinitely by default unless a custom retention period is set; minimum custom retention is 30 days (each month counted as 30 days). For projects, the retention clock starts from the project's last update (new chat or knowledge-base change); project-level retention supersedes per-chat retention. Tightening retention deletes out-of-window data immediately and permanently on save; all retention actions are logged in audit logs.

execution_and_isolation.sandbox_isolation_model: No user-facing VM/container/worktree model — Projects are a managed cloud chat context, not a code-execution sandbox. Isolation is logical/account-scoped: each project's knowledge and instructions are partitioned, and org-level tenancy isolates Team/Enterprise data (with optional customer-managed keys and data-residency region). Any code execution (e.g., analysis/artifacts) runs inside Anthropic's managed runtime, not a user-controlled sandbox. [uncertain]
execution_and_isolation.snapshot_state_restore: Not applicable in the filesystem/environment sense. There is no saveable machine/env state for a Project — only the conversation history, knowledge-base files, and instructions persist. There is no separate filesystem/package snapshot independent of conversation content.
execution_and_isolation.cloud_local_handoff: Cloud-only product (web, Desktop, Mobile apps) backed by Anthropic's hosted service. No self-hosting and no cloud-to-local execution handoff for Projects. (Anthropic's separate Claude Code CLI is a different product line.)
execution_and_isolation.parallelism_subagent_fanout: Single-conversation interaction model from the user's perspective; a user can hold multiple independent conversations within a project but there is no managed parallel-agent/worktree fanout in the consumer Projects product. No coordinator/sub-agent orchestration exposed here. [uncertain]
execution_and_isolation.trigger_surface: Sessions are initiated through the Claude.ai web app, Claude Desktop app, and Claude mobile apps. Projects are not triggered via Slack/GitHub/cron in this consumer product. Authentication is the same account login across surfaces.

implementation.implementation_stack: Proprietary, hosted by Anthropic; internal stack not publicly documented. Known characteristics: account-based auth via Google/Apple OAuth and email magic links (Enterprise SSO/SAML); cloud-managed conversation + knowledge-base storage with caching of project content (excluded from usage limits); RAG-based retrieval over the project knowledge base and over chat history; configurable Enterprise data retention, residency region, customer-managed keys, and audit logging. Exact databases, caching layer, and event format are undisclosed. [uncertain]
implementation.applicability_to_labmate: Strong mapping. Claude Projects validates a project_id as an abstract, account-scoped workspace key — analogous to a Labmate workspace_id stored as a MongoDB document holding instructions + knowledge-base references, with conversations linked by project_id. The two-tier history (per-project search vs. global-non-project search) maps to scoping LangGraph thread_id retrieval by workspace vs. user. The cached, usage-exempt knowledge base maps to a curated source corpus retrieved via RAG (Mongo/vector store) rather than re-injected each turn. The layered memory model (durable user-authored instructions + opt-in reviewable cross-thread memory + ephemeral thread state) maps cleanly to Labmate's MongoDB long-term docs + Redis Streams active-session state (TTL) + LangGraph checkpointing. Enterprise retention-from-last-update and audit logging suggest implementing per-workspace TTL anchored to last activity and an audit trail. Identity model (required verified account, OAuth/SSO) supports using the Discord connector identity as the user key, with org isolation analogous to Team/Enterprise tenancy.
